People have been asking what they need to do before they get off while they still have 10-15 min on shift while we are still busy. I know one person can’t do it all but if we split up shift changes and have people do these while we have few cars then it helps everything flow. I notice a lot of people stand around when we aren’t busy and I have to give them things to do or they just talk.
